article_title: Recent rainfall predicts broader frog acoustic participation without stronger residual co-calling associations
supported_claims: In NAAMP, more recent rainfall is associated with a greater probability of multispecies calling across all standardized surveyed stops, and this rain association remains after temperature and nonlinear day-of-year adjustment.
In NAAMP, more recent rainfall is associated with a greater probability that a standardized stop contains any caller and with a larger run-level acoustically active species pool.

In NAAMP, rain does not detectably strengthen species multiplicity within already-active stops, observed-minus-independence residual co-calling, fixed-marginal shuffle residual co-calling, mean pairwise excess covariance, or pairwise network density.
In FrogID, among recordings already conditioned on acoustic activity, recent rainfall is strongly associated with multiple rather than single calling species.
The NAAMP and FrogID activity-conditioned components do not agree: NAAMP conditional OR is 0.988 (95% CI 0.959–1.017) while FrogID conditional OR is 0.853 (95% CI 0.827–0.879).
Within each system's native estimand, the rain direction persists after removing static spatial differences within routes or ERA5 cells.
The hierarchy-corrected NAAMP seasonal-shoulder interaction remains unsupported.

interpretation.strongest: In standardized NAAMP monitoring, the rainfall-associated multispecies signal is concentrated in broader participation across sampling units and run-level pool breadth rather than detectable strengthening of within-active-unit or residual co-calling.
interpretation.frogid_role: FrogID is an external activity-conditioned contrast, not a direct replication of the NAAMP all-stop primary effect or its activation decomposition.
interpretation.cross_system_result: The activity-conditioned component differs across systems or observation processes; the present data do not identify why.
interpretation.general_implication: Multispecies detections should not be interpreted as synchrony, facilitation, or temporal-niche reorganization without separating participation, observation conditioning, and residual association.

precision_bounds.naamp_conditional: The activity-conditioned NAAMP 95% CI (OR 0.959–1.017) excludes the adjusted all-stop NAAMP OR 0.946 on the same dryness scale; this is descriptive because denominators differ.
precision_bounds.independence_residual: The same-direction lower 95% bound is -0.00112 per SD dryness, about 8% of the magnitude of the within-route all-stop coefficient -0.01367; descriptive, not a formal equivalence test.
precision_bounds.shuffle_residual: The fixed-marginal shuffle residual gives a nearly identical lower bound (-0.00110) and P=0.368.
